name: Men
overview: Scripture reveals that men are created in the image of God as distinct from women, emphasizing the divine design for male and female (Genesis 1:27). Men are called to courage and strength, relying on God's presence in all circumstances (Joshua 1:9). Fellowship among men is vital, as they sharpen and encourage one another in faith and character (Proverbs 27:17). Additionally, men are instructed to live soberly and exhibit qualities such as faith, charity, and patience, reflecting godly maturity (Titus 2:2).
